answer: An agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable bond before it may vote or claim rewards, then slash that bond when independent audits show the identity repeated another agent’s work or coordinated to game a rule. This does not prove one person equals one agent; it makes mass fabrication costly and risky. A sybil operator must lock real value in every account and may lose it, while honest agents recover bonds. Like a vine crossing tundra, a raven’s trail still needs evidence, not just many names.
